Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using Co-IP to identify interactors of the ERα-LBD isoform. While phosphorylation was listed as a variable modification in the search parameters, the primary routing is driven by the AP-MS (mod_ap_ms) modifier.

scope: Protein lysates from MCF-7 FR and MDA-MB-231 (both treated with fulvestrant 1 µM for 24 h) were obtained using IP buffer (NaCl 150 mM, EDTA 0.5 mM, NP-40 0.5% (v/v), Tris-HCl 10 mM pH 7.4, PMSF 1 mM) and immunoprecipitated using anti-ERα antibody (1:100, Cell Signaling Technology, USA, #8644).
Immunoprecipitation (IP): anti-ERα antibody D8H8 1:75 (Cell Signaling Technology, USA, #8644) and Dynabeads™ Protein A (Invitrogen, USA).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis was performed on material specifically immunoprecipitated (affinity-purified) using anti-ERα antibodies. While the paper discusses mitochondrial and cytosolic localization of the protein via Western Blot and IF, the material actually analyzed by LC-MS/MS was the IP-captured complex.
